  • ui.progress Compose's determinate/indeterminate split is by *presence* of the `progress` argument, which is the shape `value` being an `option` gives the override: the null test picks the call, and neither branch invents a fraction.
  • ui.radio Compose's RadioButton is one option, so the group is the loop: the container is the direction the prop asks for and each option is a button beside its label.

    • Functions
  • buildApk Builds the project in dir into a debug APK at out.
  • composeColor Fully qualified rather than imported: this platform's own emitter already writes `import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color as ComposeColor`, so the bare name is not bound and an import of it would collide with that alias.
  • composeOf The colour as Compose spells it.

  • drawRectFill Each shape below draws at most twice, once per paint that is visible: a transparent fill or stroke is not painted at all rather than painted with nothing, which is what the alpha tests say.
  • drawRectStroke
  • drawTextShim The two drawings a native declaration cannot describe: text reaches a `Paint` by chained property access and an image goes through a safe-call chain ending in a `let`.
  • f32 SNGL's `float` is a Kotlin `Double` and Compose's geometry is `Float`, so the conversion is written where the value crosses.
  • install Builds the project in dir, makes sure a device is attached -- starting an emulator where none is -- installs the APK, launches it and follows its log until it exits.

  • rect Compose's `Path.arcTo` takes a bounding box and two angles in *degrees*, where the command gives three points and a radius -- so the corner is solved by `sngl:ui/draw` and only the box and the degrees are built here.

  • strokeCap The names are SNGL's and the values Compose's, the same mapping gtk4 writes for cairo's enums.
  • strokeJoin
  • strokeOf Compose's `Stroke` carries the cap and the join, so `strokeStyle` takes the whole style rather than just the width -- android read `lineCap` and `lineJoin` nowhere before this and the two reached its `CanvasStyle` data class to be ignored (#223).
